final: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_name), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM per_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg) SELECT event_name, avg_amount, difference, avg_amount / (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM kept) AS ratio FROM kept ORDER BY event_name
